data.title: 双叶理央 · 实验室的烧杯咖啡
data.description: 放学后的科学部休息桌，理央放下一只烧杯造型的干净咖啡杯，白大褂袖口挽好，长发扎起。实验用品与食物分区放置，她对着咖啡和合起的笔记短暂放松，夕阳照亮眼镜后的棕瞳。
data.action: 放学后的科学部休息桌，理央放下一只烧杯造型的干净咖啡杯，白大褂袖口挽好，长发扎起
data.promptProse: Rio sets a clean beaker-shaped coffee mug on the science club's separate break table and studies its surface intently. Her white-coat sleeves are rolled above the wrists and long hair tied back. In the medium portrait, a closed notebook sits beside the mug; experimental equipment remains in the distant work area. Window sunset warms her brown eyes behind the glasses and casts the mug's rounded shadow across the table.
